description_en: During special occasions such asjātrāand other festivities, the residents of Sunaguthi are supposed to worship four religious sites in the Sunaguthi area. This Mahākāla shrine is one of those four sites. On such occasions, long lines of devotees stand and queue in front of the shrine.The shrine contains a statue of Mahākāla (38 × 27 cm) and is located inside the south-facingshikhara-style temple. Mahākāla is standing on top of a corpse and holdingkartikā,kapālaandkhaṭvāṅga. A square stone pillar with a lotus pedestal on top of it stands to the west of the structure. This pillar was erected in 1951 (VS 2008) by Guru Kavi Prasada after he organised thesaptāhabhajanain Sunaguthi. Next to it, a wooden post supports a small bell bearing an inscription from VS 2031 (1974 CE). A copper plate inscription can be found on the western wall of the shrine and states that the statue was restored in 2001 CE (VS 2058).
description_ne: सुनागुथिवासीले वस्तीभित्रका जात्रा-पर्व एवं विशेष अवसरहरूमा अनिवार्य रूपमा चार देवस्थलहरूमा पूज्नु पर्ने मान्यता रहेको छ । यो महाकाल ती चारमध्यको एक हो । जात्रा-पर्व एवं विशेष साइतहरूमा महाकाललाई पूज्न आउने श्रद्धालुहरूको लाम लाग्ने गर्दछ । दक्षिणभिमुख सानो शिखराकार संरचनामा खोपो बनाई महाकालको स्थानक मूर्ति (३८ × २७ सेमी) राखिएको छ । शवमाथि उभिएका महाकालले कर्तिका, कपाल र खट्वाङ्ग लिएका छन् ।महाकालको मूर्ति स्थापनाबारे जानकारी दिने अभिलेख प्राप्त छैन । विसं २०५८ सालमा मूर्ति राखिएको संरचनालाई जीर्णोद्धार गरी राखिएको ताम्रपत्र पश्चिमी भित्तामा टाँसिएको छ । विसं २००८ सालमा वैष्णव गुरु कवि प्रसादले सुनागुथिमा सप्ताह कीर्तन सम्पन्न गरी ठड्याएको शिलास्तम्भ महाकाल मन्दिर नजिकै रहेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The inscription mentions a one week long religious ceremony (Saptāha Kīrtana). Appaerntly this was organised by a Vaiṣṇava guru called Kavi Prasāda during the reign of King Mahendra.
A small bell was offered to Mahākāla.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of construction materials and offering of a new pinnacle and ilā̃
historical_events.event_description: During the restoration of the shrine, Mr. Rāmacandra Maharjana donated one tractor of sand and made an offering of a new pinnacle andilā̃.Mr. Kṛṣṇabhakta Maharjana donated cement and the funds for the workers' wages.
